chunks: Yunus narrated from Zurara from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) regarding
a man who said to his wife, 'You did not come to me as a virgin.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'There is nothing upon him because virginity can be lost without sexual intercourse.'
ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic legal ruling if a husband claims his wife was not a virgin?
ai.summary: In this ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), the absence of a penalty for the husband's claim highlights the legal principle that virginity is not exclusively defined by consummation, as it can be lost through non-sexual means like injury or medical procedures. This distinction is crucial in Shia jurisprudence for determining the validity of *khula'* (divorce by mutual consent) or financial compensation, ensuring that husbands cannot arbitrarily accuse wives of pre-marital infidelity without concrete proof of sexual loss.
